offers_products.reason: Makes fluid handling products, doctor blades, fiber processing systems, balers and bulk material handling equipment.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is mainly equipment, systems and consumables; services such as installation and monitoring are ancillary to the products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells industrial equipment and consumables only to process-industry businesses, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are paper, packaging, tissue, wood products, mining and food processing manufacturers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Aftermarket consumables and parts, such as doctor blades and rotary joints, are repeat purchases and make up most of revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Customers in paper, packaging, wood products can postpone capital equipment orders like stock-preparation systems and balers in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Largest part is consumables and parts (doctor blades, rotary joints, fluid handling); capital systems like stock preparation are a smaller part.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured equipment and consumables, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Sells to large paper, packaging, tissue, pulp and wood-products producers and other process-industry manufacturers worldwide.

asset_heavy.reason: Designs and manufactures engineered equipment in modest plants; growth doesn't need fleets or networks, unlike utilities or heavy manufacturing.

notes: Recurring split is uncertain: Kadant has a large aftermarket parts and consumables share alongside capital equipment.
